## What are you trying to do?

Describe the problem or use case. If this is a new indicator, name it and link
a reference implementation/spec if you have one (TA-Lib, a paper, another library).

## Proposed solution

What would the API look like? For a new indicator, note whether it's
TA-Lib-lineage (`timeperiod`-style params) or native (`period`-style params) —
see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#adding-or-changing-an-indicator).

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other libraries that already do this.

## Additional context

Anything else — links, benchmarks, related issues/discussions.
